column1: # U9GL game-data manifest: every file the release ships and the game never writes, by SHA-256.
# Rows are folder, file, bytes, SHA-256, build. Folder '.' is the game folder itself.
# Built 2026-09-20 from a pristine GOG install.
# The Steam release (2026-11-06) shares every file but u9.exe, which is 1.19F signed by EA: a second u9.exe row.
# FW 1.19.01 is the Forgotten World team's 1.19F Patch Fix 1 (music triggers, 2010-12-27): it replaces triggers.flx
# and leaves triggers-backup.flx, a copy of the 1.19F triggers.flx. Measured 2026-11-25 by installing it on a pristine GOG install.
# FW 1.19G is the companion and music fix (2010-12-27), installed over FW 1.19.01: it replaces triggers.flx,
# activity.flx, highway.dat and nonfixed.9. Measured 2026-11-25 the same way.
# FW 1.19H (2012-08-26), installed over FW 1.19G: it replaces triggers.flx, activity.flx, highway.dat, nonfixed.9
# and nonfixed.22. Its highway.dat is byte for byte FW 1.19G's, so that file has a row for each. Measured 2026-11-25;
# the same hashes as the 1.19H rows measured 2026-09-20 and parked then.
# DP 1.4 (2001-01-22) and DP 1.5 (2001-03-25) are the Dialogue Patch (fansforultima.com): it replaces text.flx,
# TYPENAME.FLX and BOOKS-EN.FLX. 1.5 differs from 1.4 only in text.flx; the other two are the same file in both,
# so each has a row for each. Its text.flx calls the Avatar Grandor until u9name.exe renames them, after which
# the file matches neither row. Its zip carries two BOOKS-EN.FLX, one with Novum's Economy Patch (shop lists):
# that one is DP and Economy both. Monster is Novum's Monster Patch, the NPC.FLX in the same zip (1.4 and 1.5
# alike). Measured 2026-11-26 from the zips' files, not by installing them.
# DP 1.6 (readme "ver 1.6", files 2001-09-26; u9fanpatch160.zip) differs from 1.5 only in text.flx: 390 of its 7,656
# entries, 362 of them spacing and punctuation, 28 reworded. Its other ten files are 1.5's byte for byte, so TYPENAME.FLX
# and both BOOKS-EN.FLX have a DP 1.6 row too, and its NPC.FLX is the Monster row. Measured 2026-11-26 from the zip.
# A sixth column marks a row: backup is a patch's copy of an original, which says nothing about what is installed.
